class: A page title's site part and 'Apply for' prefix taken as the job's title
symptom: Altamira on Jobvite, 30 September: the job was recorded as 'Altamira Technologies Corp. Careers - Apply for Network Engineer' at 'Altamiracorps'.
site: Jobvite; any careers site titled '<Company> Careers - Apply for <Job>'
root_cause: _clean_page_title split only at ' | ' and long dashes, never at ' - ' (a job title may contain one), and kept 'Apply for'; page_identity then had no site part to name the employer and fell back to the address.
why_tests_missed: Page titles met before used '|' or a long dash between the job and the site.
fix: _title_parts splits at ' - ' too when exactly one side names the careers site ('... Careers', 'Jobs at ...'), so a hyphen inside a job title is kept; _clean_page_title drops 'Apply for' / 'Job application for'; page_identity takes the employer from the site part.
prevention: Split a page title by meaning (which part names the site), not by one separator character.
